activity.notes: Tribhuvan was restored to effective kingship during the February 1951 settlement that ended hereditary Rana rule and remained King of Nepal until his death on 13 March 1955.

sources.title: Nepal Tourism Board — Nepal's History
sources.citation_text: Nepal Tourism Board states that Tribhuvan was reinstated as head of state following the overthrow of the Rana regime in the early 1950s.

sources.title: Nehru Archive — To the King of Nepal, 7 November 1952
sources.citation_text: The archival annotation records the February 1951 settlement and Tribhuvan's 18 February proclamation ending Rana family rule.

sources.title: British Museum — Tribhuvan Bir Bikram, King of Nepal
sources.citation_text: The British Museum gives Tribhuvan's life dates as 1906-1955 and his rule as 1911-1955.
